details: Upstream bbae7e0 built with the release, Metal, quantized-T5, progress, and embedded-asset feature set.
The upstream Rust suite passed 35 tests with zero failures, including Pi transcript parsing.
The binary, Pi skill, and Pi extension were installed locally; no hosted memory API was used.
The exact parent already runs both Nanny and Au Pair through ephemeral Pi SDK agents.
Global Pi skills and extensions remain disabled inside governed helper sessions; helpers receive only brokered tools and scoped context.
A failing-first producer test covered the inspect-to-watch race and durable bridge appends.
A failing-first producer test covered persisted five-minute reconciliation evidence.
A second worker lifetime preserves the original reconciliation startedAt while advancing durable heartbeat state.
Filesystem events are hints only; bridge JSONL and claims remain authoritative.
A metadata-only version probe covers coalesced filesystem events without repeatedly parsing the journal.
Claude PreCompact checkpoints synchronously before the hook journal append.
Codex uses a documented pre-turn fallback because its current hook surface has no stable pre-compaction event.
Repeated boundaries are idempotent, exact hook cursors and repository identity are persisted, and secrets are redacted.
Curated promotion accepts only allowlisted stable classes with checkpoint provenance and writes Markdown plus a JSON sidecar.
Missing provenance and transient or unverified claims fail closed.
Lint, targeted typecheck, compiled build, and every sequential test file passed outside the restricted sandbox.
The restricted-sandbox run failed only because the proxy integration could not bind loopback; the exact test then passed outside the sandbox with 1 test, 0 failures, and 6 expectations.

known_limitations: This slice does not deploy or mutate a live loop.
The local-only Honcho bakeoff remains a subsequent isolated slice.
Codex has no stable pre-compaction hook in the current provider surface, so its checkpoint is taken before each user turn.
notes: The event-driven bridge and checkpoint/promotion implementation pass the mandatory repository verification contract. The checkpoint-focused tests passed 5 tests and 15 expectations; the hook suite passed 33 tests and 94 expectations. The full mandatory verifier passed outside the restricted sandbox, including lint, targeted typecheck, compiled build, and every sequential test file. Exact-SHA supervisor review remains required before deployment.
